chapter: Kansas City bands and the Blue Devils
title: Lester Young's tone and how Durham voiced him in the Basie saxophones
summary: Lester's whispery tone was bad against Hawkins' sound, so Durham wrote him high on the C melody part next to the second alto, never on the root.
